source: Congressional Record parliamentary conventions (recognition / yielding / page furniture)
rationale: Floor and Extensions text is dense with procedural furniture a naive n-gram counter reads as 'coordination'. These seed the CREC-lane boilerplate suppression, applied at n-gram time exactly as the press spine suppresses its own boilerplate. Genre-specific: NEVER applied to the press lane.
phrase_seeds: i reserve the balance of my time
suggest the absence of a quorum
procedural_formulas: the committee of the whole house on the state of the union had under consideration the bill
committee of the whole house on the state of the union
the house in committee of the whole
pursuant to the order of the house
mr speaker i yield myself such time as i may consume
note: phrase_seeds/procedural_formulas are lowercased; suppress an ngram that IS a contiguous substring of a procedural_formula OR contains a phrase_seed. header_patterns strip Record page furniture pre-tokenization. bill_title_seeds flag legislative-title language (the nomenclature-segregation problem) — a coordination metric on CREC must strip these, else bill titles read as message coordination.
amend_policy: extend during D1 with dated amendments in docs/15 §9 only

Added procedural_formulas + bill_title_seeds.
